The docs already use "rest at the inn" as the worked example for this exact scenario. Here's the complete file list:

## Worker

| # | File | Change |
|---|------|--------|
| 1 | `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` type; add a cost constant (e.g. `INN_REST_COST`) |
| 2 | `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | `export const restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()`; validate body, `getCharacter`, check `gold >= cost`, then `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` via `services/character.ts:94` (whitelisted fields only); optionally `askDM` for narration + `appendHistory`/`saveSession` + `adventure_log` insert, following the pattern in `routes/action.ts` |
| 3 | `worker/src/index.ts:41-48` | Mount route: `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)` |
| 4 | `worker/src/services/character.ts` | Only if HP/gold logic needs to be shared beyond the route itself |
| 5 | `worker/migrations/000N_*.sql` (new) | Only if schema changes are needed (e.g. inn location/cost data) — never edit `0001` |

## Frontend

| # | File | Change |
|---|------|--------|
| 6 | `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Response interface mirroring the Worker's rest response type |
| 7 | `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | New method `rest(sessionId, characterId)` → `POST ${API_BASE}/api/rest` |
| 8 | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` + `.html` | New "Rest at the Inn" button/handler: calls the API, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`, pushes a system/narrative log entry |
| 9 | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Tests with `GameApiService` mocked as a Jasmine spy |

**Rules:** gold/HP math stays in the Worker (never computed client-side); CORS origins live in `worker/src/index.ts:19-35` if a new frontend origin is added; Angular files stay split `.ts/.html/.css/.spec.ts` (no inline templates).
